verdict.rationale: Aleph documents its own team and user permissions and 'fine-grained permissions' for controlling access to sensitive data, and it positions budget planning around budget owners collaborating. However, no evidence shows that permissions can be scoped to a department, dimension, or cost center, or that a budget owner can be given edit rights to their own numbers only. Missing for 10: explicit department- or dimension-scoped permissions, a separate edit-versus-view grant for budget owners, documentation of how scoping is configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, department-scoped permissions let a budget owner see and edit their numbers without exposing the whole company

citations.quote: Team and user permissions provide complete control over who can access sensitive data.
access controls, fine-grained permissions, audit logs, and more
a collaborative solution that budget owners will actually update and monitor
